description:
A new way to collaborate

Empowering teams by messenger, meetings, calendar, docs, and emails. It's all in one place.
Feishu Forms
- Two new question types are now available:
- Formula: Automatically run calculations on fields from the current table or across linked tables. You can also use AI to generate formulas for a wide range of use cases.
- Lookup: Reference fields in the base to show the original field values or calculation results.
